name: shield guardian
lore:
Imagine stumbling upon an ancient laboratory, dust motes dancing in shafts of light filtering through grimy windows. In the center stands a towering figure, crafted from wood, stone, and metal, its form vaguely humanoid but undeniably artificial. This is a shield guardian, a construct of immense power and unwavering loyalty, bound to protect its master at any cost.

These guardians are not mere automatons; they possess a magical link to a special amulet, the key to their control. Through this amulet, a master can command the guardian, even across vast distances, and the guardian will obey with tireless dedication. Whether deflecting blows with uncanny speed or unleashing stored spells, a shield guardian is a formidable ally, a silent sentinel against the dangers that lurk in the shadows. But beware, for should the amulet be destroyed, the guardian becomes inert, a lifeless statue awaiting a new master and a new purpose.
